findings.title: Dead letters pile up in Recovery
findings.message: Nothing in the diagram reads or alerts on Recovery: failed messages stay there until someone looks.

fix.label: Add a reader…
fix.needsChoice: Pick what reads Recovery, then add it and connect dead to it.

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
